sandbox.create.title: Create a sandbox
sandbox.create.description: Create a sandbox Create a new sandbox in the production organization. Typical usage: - Create a sandbox for safe testing (configuration changes, integrations, extensions). - After creation, use `GET /sandboxes/{sandbox_id}` to verify status and `GET /sandboxes/{sandbox_id}/changes` once changes accumulate.

sandbox.create-push.title: Push changes to production
sandbox.create-push.description: Push changes to production Deploy sandbox component changes to the production organization. Recommended flow: - Gather `change_ids` from `GET /sandboxes/{sandbox_id}/changes` - Validate using `POST /sandboxes/{sandbox_id}/changes/validatepush` - Push here with the same `change_ids`

change_ids.description: List of change IDs (from the changes listing APIs).

component_ids.description: List of component IDs (primarily for mark as reviewed/unreviewed).

sandbox.create-validatepush.title: Validate push to production
sandbox.create-validatepush.description: Validate push to production Validate that the selected sandbox changes can be pushed to the production organization. Provide `change_ids` in the request body. Use the response to detect blockers/conflicts before attempting the actual push.

change_ids.description: List of change IDs (from the changes listing APIs).

component_ids.description: List of component IDs (primarily for mark as reviewed/unreviewed).

sandbox.delete.title: Delete a sandbox
sandbox.delete.description: Delete a sandbox Delete the sandbox from the production organization. Notes: - Use `force_delete=true` only if you intend to delete the sandbox regardless of its current state. - Deleting a sandbox is destructive; consider auditing with `GET /sandboxes/logs` beforehand.

sandbox.get.title: Get a sandbox
sandbox.get.description: Get a sandbox Get configuration details of a particular sandbox. Use this to: - Confirm sandbox metadata (name/description/active status). - Validate that a `sandbox_id` from listing is still valid.

sandbox.list.title: List all sandboxes
sandbox.list.description: List all sandboxes Get all sandbox configurations available for the production organization. Use this as the first step to obtain `sandbox_id` values for subsequent operations (view details, list changes, validate/push, rebuild, etc.).

sandbox.list-changes.title: List changes in production org
sandbox.list-changes.description: List changes in production org Get all available component changes from the sandbox in the production organization context. This is the primary "what will be deployed?" API. Typical flow: - Call this to gather candidate `change_ids`. - Optionally validate with `POST /sandboxes/{sandbox_id}/changes/validatepush`. - Deploy with `POST /sandboxes/{sandbox_id}/changes/push`.

sandbox.list-changes-2.title: List changes in sandbox org
sandbox.list-changes-2.description: List changes in sandbox org Get all changes within the **sandbox organization** context. Use this when operating inside sandbox to triage what changed: - `change_type` is required (`new_changes` or `tested_changes`). - Optionally filter by `status` (e.g., already deployed vs pending).

status.description: Filter by deployment status (e.g. deployed, yet_to_be_deployed).

sandbox.list-editpage.title: Get sandbox edit page details
sandbox.list-editpage.description: Get sandbox edit page details Fetch edit-page context for a sandbox (production org context). Use this when building administrative tooling (or MCP actions) that needs: - Sandbox details used by edit UI - Sharing/visibility information (see `shared_to` in response)

sandbox.list-logs.title: List deployment logs
sandbox.list-logs.description: List deployment logs Fetch sandbox deployment logs (audit trail) from the production organization context. Use this to: - Audit pushes or sync operations - Trace who deployed what and when (optionally filter by `sandbox_id` or `user_id`) - Build "recent activity" views for admins and MCP tools.

page.description: Page number.

per_page.description: Number of records per page.

filter_by.description: Filter for deployment logs.

sandbox.update.title: Update a sandbox
sandbox.update.description: Update a sandbox Edit sandbox configurations (e.g., name/description). Use `GET /sandboxes/editpage` if you need UI-oriented edit context (such as share targets) before updating.

sandbox.update-markasreviewed.title: Mark changes as reviewed
sandbox.update-markasreviewed.description: Mark changes as reviewed Mark sandbox components/changes as reviewed (ready to deploy) in the sandbox org context. Provide `change_ids` and/or `component_ids` depending on what you are marking.

change_ids.description: List of change IDs (from the changes listing APIs).

component_ids.description: List of component IDs (primarily for mark as reviewed/unreviewed).

sandbox.update-markasunreviewed.title: Mark changes as unreviewed
sandbox.update-markasunreviewed.description: Mark changes as unreviewed Mark sandbox components or changes as unreviewed in the sandbox org context. Use this to revert "ready to deploy" status for the selected items.

change_ids.description: List of change IDs (from the changes listing APIs).

component_ids.description: List of component IDs (primarily for mark as reviewed/unreviewed).

sandbox.update-rebuild.title: Rebuild sandbox
sandbox.update-rebuild.description: Rebuild sandbox Rebuild the sandbox. Use this when the sandbox needs to be refreshed/recreated from production state (exact behavior may vary by rollout and org settings).

sandbox.update-status.title: Activate or deactivate sandbox
sandbox.update-status.description: Activate or deactivate sandbox Activate or deactivate a sandbox. Use this to temporarily disable sandbox usage without deleting it.

active.description: Set to true to activate, false to deactivate.
